item.title: Mapping human interactions to entropy reduction
item.description: REDACTED. Old meter. Not the Codex. A NotebookLM debate on the Extropy Engine. Is mapping human work onto verified delta S - via a local DAG, no fiat on-ramp, and a proxy that gets less wrong as the graph fills - a rigorous answer to broken rewards, or a category error that measures the exhaust of a ride instead of the reason for it? Codex v2.1, the mint formula, LocalFlow, DFAO scale, standing unbundled from XP.
